escenas.texto: This week in Asia, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over four hundred and fifty-one million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Asia edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Asia. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from Pakistan, Top Pakistani Dramas, with a video posted four days ago. Over thirteen million views. A video over thirty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over nine thousand comments.

Next up, number nine, from India, FactoHolic, with a video posted five days ago. Over thirteen million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over three thousand comments.

Next up, number eight, from India, Ghibli Wali Vibes, with “It was hot summer night..until Grandma went rooftop .”. Over fifteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about eighteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just forty-three seconds.

In position number seven, あり | 幼児が夢中になる遊び🎖️, with “チラシをパンチして...”. Over fifteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about forty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nineteen seconds.

Coming in at number six, from India, Shouvik Datta Banik • 256M Views • 7 days ago, with a video posted six days ago. Over fifteen million views. A Short of just nine seconds. It also has one hundred and thirty-one comments.

In position number five, from India, Dangal TV Channel, with a video posted three days ago. Over fifteen million views. A video over twenty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one thousand comments.

In position number four, from Japan, IORI GAME ROOM, with a video posted four days ago. Over sixteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ninety thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-three seconds.
Bronze medal, from India, Ashutosh Kumar, with a video posted five days ago. Over sixteen million views. It also has over sixteen thousand comments.
Silver medal, from Japan, MY💝No War🤝, with “Wait all the cokes erupt at once?!”. Over twenty-eight million views. A Short of just twenty-four seconds. It also has over three thousand comments.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from India, Samay Raina, with “INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP9 ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale”. Over thirty-seven million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and ten thousand views per hour. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. At number ten, from India, Mythpat, with a video posted one day ago. Over four thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over three point one million views.

Next up, number nine, Shane Boland, with “This is why I never trust the outside of a log”. Over six thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-six thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over five million views.
At number eight, 飯島レンジ / Renji Iijima, with a video posted four days ago. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over eleven million views.
In position number seven, from India, Netflix India, with “Dhindora 2 Official Trailer Bhuvan Bam Netflix India”. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over ten million views.

In position number six, from Pakistan, Top Pakistani Dramas, with a video posted four days ago. Over nine thousand comments. A video over thirty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirteen million views.
Next up, number five, from India, Shivang Mini, with a video posted one day ago. Over ten thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over one million views.
Coming in at number four, from India, Ashutosh Kumar, with a video posted five days ago. Over sixteen thousand comments. It also has over sixteen million views.

Bronze medal, from India, Samay Raina, with “INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP9 ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale”. Over twenty-one thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and ten thousand views per hour. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Silver medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “We bought the most expensive house gta 5 gameplay”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over one hundred and fourteen minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And finally, number one most commented, from India, ProBoiz 95, with “Darkheroes: sheng has arrived!! season 4 episode 1”. Over twenty-eight thousand comments. A video over sixty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four point seven million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, 飯島レンジ / Renji Iijima, with a video posted four days ago. Over two hundred and twenty-three thousand likes. It also has over eleven million views.

Coming in at number nine, Скелес Эдит, with a video posted five days ago. Over two hundred and seventy-five thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over seven point seven million views.

Number eight, from Japan, MY💝No War🤝, with “Wait all the cokes erupt at once?!”. Over two hundred and ninety thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-four seconds. It also has over twenty-eight million views.

Next up, number seven, from India, Facts' Mine, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and eight thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-three seconds. It also has over nine point four million views.

At number six, from Indonesia, anothersideofdila, with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and ninety-one thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: six out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over six point seven million views.

In position number five, from India, Kuldeep Singhania Shorts, with a video posted three days ago. Over three hundred and ninety-six thousand likes. A Short of just forty seconds. It also has over nine point four million views.

Next up, number four, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “We bought the most expensive house gta 5 gameplay”. Over four hundred and sixty-three thousand likes. A video over one hundred and fourteen minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.
Bronze medal, from India, Ashutosh Kumar, with a video posted five days ago. Over four hundred and sixty-five thousand likes. It also has over sixteen million views.
Silver medal, from India, FactoHolic, with a video posted five days ago. Over six hundred and seventy thousand likes. It also has over thirteen million views.

And finally, number one most liked, from India, Samay Raina, with “INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP9 ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale”. Over nine hundred and thirty-six thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and ten thousand views per hour. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Africa. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Asia every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
